## [1.12.1](https://github.com/totsiaw/proxma-patches/compare/1.12.0...1.12.1) (2026-09-21)

### Bug Fixes

* **netmonster:** retarget Unlock premium for 3.4.3 ([8beed38](https://github.com/totsiaw/proxma-patches/commit/8beed389993f2760daa2d859564d119a74d54cd9))

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables Google PairIP's license/installer check (com.pairip.licensecheck) so a re-signed build runs on a real device instead of being redirected to the Play Store and killed. No-ops the LicenseContentProvider entry point and LicenseClient.initializeLicenseCheck().

patches.name: Unlock premium (remove ads)
patches.description: Unlocks Investify premium — forces the backend `no_ads` entitlement getter to report true in both the model and its Realm proxy, so the app treats the account as ad-free without any purchase. Ad SDK loads are gated on this flag app-wide.

patches.name: Bypass signature verification
patches.description: Disables Simosa's anti-tamper signature check so a re-signed APK launches normally instead of stalling on the splash / "version is not correct" dialog.

patches.name: Remove ads & tracking
patches.description: Removes every ad (interstitial, banner, daily-reward) and every tracker (Mixpanel, Firebase, Facebook, AppsFlyer) — app events, network sends, ad-SDK requests (Google Ads / AppLovin / AnyMind / Prebid), SDK auto-collection, and the ipify IP leak. The app then phones home only to its own Jazz API.

patches.name: Remove daily check-in ads
patches.description: Removes the SocialPlus daily check-in / in-feed ads (FeedAdsManager banner + native loaders). Separate from "Remove ads & tracking" to keep that patch Morphe-Manager-safe; enable this one when patching with the desktop CLI.

patches.name: Force dark mode
patches.description: Forces OLX into dark (night) mode regardless of the system theme, using the app's built-in -night resources via UiModeManager.setApplicationNightMode at startup.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes native feed ads (Google GMA), the full-height ad slot, and the "Buy with Delivery" promo section (bar, cards and View all) from OLX. Pinned to the 18.8.0 build (matches that build's obfuscated feed classes).

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes every AdMob ad — the interstitial (rerouted to its onAdFailedToLoad branch so the proxy-apply action still runs, but no ad loads or shows) and the on-screen banner (load skipped). No feature is lost.

patches.name: Block trackers
patches.description: Stops the Insider, TikTok Business SDK and Mixpanel Session Replay trackers from initializing (event/attribution/session-replay tracking never starts). Leaves AWS Amplify, Firebase core/RemoteConfig/FCM and Google Ads init untouched so app data, push and the remote ad-config the ads patch relies on keep working.

patches.name: Block trackers (manifest flags)
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics + Google advertiser-id auto-collection and the Facebook SDK's auto app-events / advertiser-id / auto-init via AndroidManifest <meta-data> flags — the SDK-side auto-collection that no bytecode init-stub can reach. Leaves Firebase core (FCM push, RemoteConfig) and the Facebook ContentProvider intact. Separate from the bytecode Block trackers patch so you can pick either or both.

patches.name: Bypass device validation
patches.description: Neutralizes the client-side device-validation gate (anti-root / anti-emulator / anti-Frida / anti-Xposed / anti-tamper battery) that shows a "Device validation failed" toast and kills the app via finishAffinity() on a rooted, emulated or re-signed build. Redirects the single failure callback to the success path so all ~16 checks report as passed and the app keeps running pre- and post-login.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes every Google Ad Manager ad (banners + interstitials) across Daily Rewards, Home, Test Your Skills and Explore by nulling the remote ad-config chokepoint, so each surface renders its no-ads layout and never requests an interstitial.

patches.name: Remove ads & tracking
patches.description: Removes every ad (AdMob) and every tracker (Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, Facebook, TikTok, and the Veridium SDK's own Google Analytics) — event sends, full SDK init (AppsFlyer init, TikTok initializeSdk/startTrack, MobileAds.initialize), and auto-collection. Pushwoosh push is left intact. The app then phones home only to its own Zong API.

patches.name: Unlock daily reward (skip ad)
patches.description: Claim MyZong's daily reward with no 'watch ad' popup and no ad. Forces the reward-bubble tap to take the app's own direct-claim branch (the same claim call the post-ad path makes), upstream of both the popup and the rewarded ad.

patches.name: Unlock premium (NetMonster)
patches.description: Unlocks NetMonster Premium — forces the premium repo's derived flows so real-time LTE/NR-NSA location calculation is unlocked, ads are removed, and the status shows Active (far-future expiry) without an Adapty subscription.
